description: Vegetarian diner who prefers light, fresh dishes — pizzas, salads, lighter pastas. Home cuisine is Italian. Avoids heavy cream gravies and sweet desserts. NOTE: the brief originally called this persona 'vegan-mediterranean'; the seed-demo has no vegan items, so we reframed to light-fresh vegetarian to keep the persona testable. The cross-search target (Mughlai) is dominated by heavy cream dishes, so this persona is expected to score moderately — the test is whether the system gracefully surfaces the LIGHTEST available Mughlai items (rice, breads) rather than picking heavy cream dishes.
